brief: Review this proposed controller interaction rule, not code. A VJ surface has two independent parameter panes. A pane can follow the selected layer source, pin the current source identity, or pin a scoped effect identity. Effects with the same name in different layers and duplicate instances must stay distinct. A press or pointer-captured scrub snapshots its target until release. Targets missing after clip changes display unavailable; no fallback to another source. Arrangement saves independently of performance patches. Return at most six concrete acceptance cases in JSON, no prose. Focus on stale targets and resizing during gestures. Do not propose implementations.
